name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Preserve and visibly resume the selected calendar date when returning from Orbit to 5wCal. If Orbit is displaying a previously selected date, reopening 5wCal now restarts the 500 ms yellow/normal blink on that date. Double tapping outside the 35 date cells (header/weekday/non-date area) clears the selection, immediately clears Orbit's selected-day offset, restores the previous cell, shows SEL CLEAR, and gives a short buzz. Selection blink timers are stopped/restarted safely across page swipes; deferred holiday repaints no longer overwrite a blinking selected cell.
